tool_args.rationale: The observations show a smooth, strong dependence on both u_now and s_grad, but no horizon variation to identify dynamics. Fit a compact quadratic response numerically to the paid rows rather than spending on irrelevant measurements. Fresh confirmation is expected to assess the fit.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its low- and high-gradient readings demonstrate gradient sensitivity.
Already acquired; the additional varied u_now/s_grad observations provide a usable training set.
All rows share H and x_now, so transfer-rate parameters are not identifiable; a numerical quadratic response is a more defensible compact fit.
It is explicitly nuisance information and does not resolve the target response law.
